methodology: Scope is every Purchase/Sale disclosed with a transaction date in the 3-year window ending 2026-10-10, read from each filing-year archive that can contain one. Estimated traded volume is the sum of disclosed range midpoints across all in-window buys and sells. Estimated shares = disclosed range midpoint / close on the transaction date; tickered buys and sells are FIFO-matched in share space for realized gains; unsold shares are marked to the latest close. Unmatched sales (positions opened before the window) and non-equity assets are excluded from gain estimates but counted as trades. Members below min_invested/min_trades are unranked. alpha_pct_estimate is the return less what SPY returned over the same holding windows, dollar-weighted the same way.
